Swift Cold Chain Project in Malaysia Progresses Over 70%
•SCGJWD, in collaboration with Swift Haulage Berhad , is building an integrated cold storage warehouse located in 
Shah Alam International Logistics Hub, just 30 km from Kuala Lumpur. 
•The facility is scheduled to open in Q 1 2026 as part of the “Cold Chain Hub in ASEAN ” expansion plan to support 
the growing cold storage industry in the region. 
•This project will connect transportation across China –Laos –Thailand –Malaysia –Singapore with end -to-end 
logistics solutions, ensuring quality, standards, and readiness at every stage.SYNERGY HIGHLIGHTS FOR 3Q2025

## Page 17

SCGJWD and SCGJWD Freight Signs Service Agreements with Thai MMA
17
SCGJWD and SCGJWD Freight, subsidiaries of SCGJWD, signed service agreements with Thai MMA, a global 
leader in chemical and acrylic sheet production under SCGC, on August 26. 
The three agreements cover comprehensive services:
•Custom -X Service : automating export 
documentation processes by linking data between 
operators and the Customs Department for Export 
Declarations and Goods Control Lists.
•Hazardous Goods Transport Service : for Monomer 
DG (Class 3,8).
•TRUCK GO System Service : a transport 
management platform accessible via website and 
mobile application, covering order management, 
trip planning, route optimization, status tracking, 
and real -time reporting.SYNERGY HIGHLIGHTS FOR 3Q2025

## Page 18

SCGJWD Signs MOU for National Digital Emergency Medical Services 
Platform (NDEMS)
•SCGJWD, together with the National Institute of Emergency Medicine and partners, signed an MOU for 
the NDEMS project to upgrade Thailand ’s emergency medical system to modern digital standards 
through Smart Logistics expertise. 
•SCGJWD will support emergency vehicle management and real -time data integration to enhance speed, 
accuracy, and safety —improving the quality of life for Thai citizens.

## Page 19

SCGJWD Joins Multimodal Transport project to BIMSTEC
•Port Authority of Thailand (PAT) and private sector partners launched the inaugural Multimodal Transport service 
to position Ranong Port as a gateway for cargo to BIMSTEC countries. 
•SCGJWD joined PAT and other companies at the opening ceremony of the Multimodal Transport project covering 
the route China –Lao PDR –Thailand –Myanmar –BIMSTEC. 
•The event also marked the first shipment to Yangon Port, Myanmar, promoting a new seamless multimodal 
transport route integrating truck, rail, and sea transportation.
